bias.en: Pullback · lost the 100-day, SAR bearish, testing $495–503
bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 100 日均线，SAR 转空，测试 $495–503

read.en: AMD fell 10.9% on Oct 30 to $504.80, trading between $492.24 and $520.40 on twice average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($548.2), falling 10-day ($539.1) and rising 30-day ($586.7) and 100-day ($529.1) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($410.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($579.18), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: AMD 10月30日大跌 10.9%，收于 $504.80，盘中区间 $492.24–520.40，成交量为均量的 2 倍。股价低于上行的 5 日（$548.2）、下行的 10 日（$539.1）以及上行的 30 日（$586.7）和 100 日均线（$529.1），仍高于上行的 200 日均线（$410.5）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图再度扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$579.18），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $560.5–568.6, $538.9–541.1 and the 100-day, now resistance, and flipped the SAR bearish. Resistance is $520.4–523.9 (Oct 30 and Oct 23 highs), then $529.1–539.1 (100 and 10-day) and $548.2 (5-day). Support is $492.2–502.6 (Oct 30, Oct 22 and Jun 29 lows), then $460.2–463.2 and $440.5–451 (July–September lows). A close above $539 would target $548; below $492, $460–463.

s.en: Oct 30 low $492.2; Oct 22 low $502.6; Jun 29 low $495.4
